messages:
priya: Heads-up: I tracked a Vite-only repro for the JS SDK where default imports turn into a non-callable object in edge runtimes. Error: \"TypeError: (0 , _redwood.default) is not a function\" after build.

matt: Oof. Which SDK version + minimal steps?

priya: Minimal repro: create vite app (vite@4 + react), package.json with \"type\": \"module\" and dependency `redwood-inference` (local link works). User code: `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'` then call `Redwood(...)`. Build with `vite build` + default rollup plugins -> deploy to Cloudflare Workers/Netlify Edge or run with edge-like loader.

jess: Does `import { createClient }` behave differently?

priya: Yes — named import works fine. Default is the problem. The bundle ends up with interop wrappers like `_interopDefaultLegacy` and the runtime resolves it as an object, not callable. Webpack and plain node ESM don't trigger this.

kai: Likely due to Vite's prebundle + esbuild CJS interop + rollup commonjs plugin ordering. Any define replacements or env defines?

priya: I had `define: { 'process.env.NODE_ENV': '"production"' }` which caused `typeof exports` checks to be inlined and changed cjs detection. I can reproduce without extra plugins though; define just made it deterministic for me.

matt: Can we get a tiny GH repo with exact package versions + a GH Actions job that runs `vite build` and then node to import the generated bundle? Add a test that fails.

priya: I'll push a repro: https://github.com/priya/repro-redwood-vite. For now workarounds: 1) use named exports (`import { createClient }`) 2) package-side: add explicit exports field and separate cjs/esm entrypoints. That fixed it when I tested publishing dual builds.

jess: Alternative short-term: publish an ESM-only build and set `exports.import` to the ESM file, drop CJS. But that breaks older Node users. Tradeoffs.

kai: For webpack users, routing the SDK through babel-loader and normalizing interop helps. For Vite, consider marking the SDK as external for optimizeDeps or add `optimizeDeps.exclude = ['redwood-inference']` so prebundle doesn't mangle it.

priya: Good tip — excluding from optimizeDeps avoids prebundle and fixes the default import shape. I'll add that to the repro README.
dev-bot: Label devex added. Created issue RW-1423 (triage needed).

matt: Follow-ups: (1) add CI coverage that runs vite build + node import, (2) decide SDK publishing policy (dual entry vs ESM-only), (3) doc a Vite consumer workaround.

priya: I'll file the SDK issue with the repro steps and link the GH repo. Planning to add a tiny action that runs build and loads `dist/server/entry.mjs` with `node --input-type=module` to replicate the edge error. Will also record the exact stack trace.

jess: When filing, include minimal package.json, vite.config.js, index handler, and the exact error output from Cloudflare or Node. That helps maintainers reproduce fast.

priya: Will do. Sharing link shortly. :slightly_smiling_face:
